items.title: Demna Calls on Tom Brady, Xiao Zhan, Ningning, Shawn Mendes and More for Gucci Primavera Campaign
items.summary: WWD covers the release of Demna's debut Gucci Primavera FW2026 campaign, photographed by Michal Chelbin, featuring a 10-person global cast including NEA-relevant ambassadors Xiao Zhan (China), Jin of BTS and Tarzzan (Korea), and Ningning of aespa (Korea/China). Demna described the concept as an 'emotional awakening' inspired by Botticelli's Primavera painting.

items.title: 肖战 Gucci 新地广全面铺开 (Xiao Zhan Gucci new outdoor ads roll out nationwide)
items.summary: Fan-media aggregation of Weibo posts tracking Xiao Zhan's rollout as the first Chinese male star featured in Gucci's official seasonal ready-to-wear global campaign (Primavera), with billboards appearing in Shanghai, Guangzhou, Shenzhen, Chengdu and Hangzhou. Coverage spans several linked Weibo posts Aug 20-25.

items.source: Sina (肖战 Gucci coverage, second post)
items.title: 肖战 Gucci 2026 秋冬全球广告及资源汇总 (Xiao Zhan Gucci FW2026 global ad resource roundup)
items.summary: Fan-community compilation post cataloguing Xiao Zhan's Gucci FW2026 global advertising placements and promotional assets, part of the broader Weibo fandom buzz around the Primavera campaign launch.

items.title: [theqoo] BTS Jin x Gucci Primavera Campaign Photoshoot
items.summary: Korean fan community (theqoo) discussion thread on Jin's Gucci Primavera photos shows mixed reaction: several commenters criticized the makeup styling and posing as 'awkward' or 'weird,' while others welcomed the new concept and praised the smokey-eye look as reminiscent of his debut era. Notably not uniformly positive despite being ambassador content.

items.title: 260825 Ningning for GUCCI Primavera Campaign (Preview)
items.summary: aespa fan community preview thread sharing Ningning's Gucci Primavera campaign images; engagement was light (single comment linking to WWD coverage), indicating a fairly muted fan reaction at time of capture rather than a viral moment.

items.title: グッチが新作バッグ「ジャッキー フラップ」発売
items.summary: Japanese trade outlet fashionsnap reports Gucci's launch of the new 'Jackie Flap' bag from the Primavera collection, derived from the archival Gucci Jackie silhouette with piston-closure hardware; available in canvas (473,000 yen) and leather (539,000 yen) versions, convertible between shoulder and crossbody wear.

items.source: Qianlong Business Studies (千龙网 新商学观察)
items.title: 古驰销售连跌12个季度，中国奢侈品消费正在发生什么改变？
items.summary: Critical-angle Chinese business-media analysis: Gucci has now posted 12 consecutive quarters of sales decline (Q2 2026 revenue EUR1.41bn, decline narrowing from -8% to -2%) while Chinese domestic luxury brands' share of category spend rose from 39% to 44%. Cites an economist describing Chinese consumers as 'reducing purchase frequency, not trading down' and unwilling to pay for logo-driven purchases without demonstrable quality; notes ~37% of Gen Z plan to cut luxury spending, and that a domestic handbag brand outsold Coach in a 2025 shopping festival.

items.title: 명품그룹, 2분기 실적 회복 국면
items.summary: Korean trade press coverage of Kering's Q2 2026 results: Gucci's comparable sales decline narrowed from -8% (Q1) to -2% (Q2), read by analysts as a turning point after prior quarters of double-digit drops; framed alongside broader luxury sector recovery (Hermes, Prada) but analysts caution China remains the key swing factor for a full Gucci recovery.
